name: Suggestion to Eat (CR 4)
body:
Source Pathfinder #2.

Type festering
Notice Perception DC 15 (to notice the phylactery shards rattle and shake); hp 8
Trigger proximity; Reset automatic (24 hours)

EFFECT

Spell effect (suggestion to eat a nearby fungus, Will DC 15 resists).
